name: Linux software installation methods
description: Guidance for Linux package ecosystems including APT/DEB, DNF/RPM, Flatpak, Snap, and AppImage. Use the distribution repository or application's official publisher source.
license_note: Package licences and redistribution rules vary by application and distribution.
notes: Use the package manager supported by the installed distribution.
Avoid random third-party mirrors and unverified scripts.
Offline installation requires matching dependencies and architecture.
